beats.care: Registered as a graduate voter? Tell your manager now and plan your 4-hour slot on Friday.
beats.what: Divisional Commissioner Sheetal Teli-Ugale said registered private-sector voters get a 4-hour concession, up from 2 hours.
beats.why: The Pune division votes on Oct 23 for Graduates' and Teachers' seats in Maharashtra's Legislative Council.

cards.body: The Graduates' seat covers Pune, Satara, Sangli, Kolhapur and Solapur districts. Only registered graduate voters can vote.
cards.title: Who votes

opts: Registered voters working in private firms
cards.q: Who gets the 4-hour break on Oct 23?
cards.why: The concession is for private-sector employees who are registered voters in these seats.

cards.q: Are you registered as a graduate voter?

cards.body: Eligible government staff get a full paid holiday, on top of their casual leave.

hook: Registered graduate voter? You may get *4 hours off* on Friday

learn.t: Only graduates who registered can vote in the Graduates' constituency; it's separate from regular elections.

sources.name: Free Press Journal
sources.title: Pune: Four-Hour Voting Break For Private Employees, Paid Holiday For Graduate & Teacher Voters On Oct 23

tldr: Registered graduate and teacher voters working in private firms get a 4-hour break to vote in the October 23 MLC poll.
watch: Polling is on October 23, 8 am to 4 pm; counting is on October 27.
